anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it might not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, which might indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to reduce load average, potentially by redistributing workloads or upgrading hardware.
Review and potentially recalibrate AI strategies to ensure they are generating opportunities and learning effectively.
Evaluate the effectiveness of current trading strategies and consider adjustments or new strategies to improve trading outcomes.
